test_title: PYST 46: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the sister of B’,

A @ B means ‘A is the brother of B’,

A - B means ‘A is the wife of B’,

and A # B means ‘A is the father of B’.

How is O related to V if ‘O - P # T + G @ V’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol →
 +
 @
 -
 #
 
 
 
 

 Meaning →
 Sister
 Brother
 Wife
 Father
 
 

Given: O - P # T + G @ V

It means: O is the wife of P, P is the father of T, T is the sister of G, and G is the brother of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc6768ee05798d446525146abfa99c89f166ccd99ac010a886867cf13920da43.png] 

So, O is the wife of P and mother in the family chain leading to V.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**
